items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: You know who sounds like him? Paul Desmond. More than anybody. He really has the sound and everything like him.

ctx.x: After the '20s, he never really had an impact on jazz again. He kind of just......

Just kind of -- yeah, he kind of like faded away. He never was successful. He had a band, a couple of bands, big bands. I remember the last one I heard was in New Orleans and I heard it on the air one night and it sounded good. I loved him, I loved the way he played, you know. I'll tell you who sounds more like him, Gary, than anybody in the world. That's why I believe everything has been done before, just like that song, 'Everything's Been Done Before.' You know who sounds like him? Paul Desmond.
